object_properties.name: teaches
object_properties.comment: Links a teacher to the course they teach.

object_properties.name: relevantToObjective
object_properties.comment: a behavioural objective can be relevant to a specific resource based on the associated game element(s)

object_properties.name: requiresLeaderboard
object_properties.comment: points associated to a resource requires the apropriate leaderboard

swrl_rules.label: designedWithObjective
swrl_rules.comment: If a gamified resource contains a game element, and that game element is relevant to a behavioural objective, then the gamified resource is also designed with that behavioural objective.

swrl_rules.label: hasEducationalTopic
swrl_rules.comment: If a gamified resource is designed with a behavioural objective, and that objective targets some topic knowledge, and that topic knowledge is about an educational topic, then the gamified resource has that educational topic.

swrl_rules.label: InferSimilarDomainBySubjectArea
swrl_rules.comment: This rule infers that two teachers have a similar domain when they are specialized in the same subject area.

swrl_rules.label: InferSimilarProfileByPlayerTypeAndTopic
swrl_rules.comment: This rule infers a profile similarity between two teachers when they have the same player type and share either:  - a similar teaching topic.

swrl_rules.label: InferSimilarProfileByPlayerTypeAndDomain
swrl_rules.comment: This rule infers a profile similarity between two teachers when they have the same player type and share either:  - the same subject area.

swrl_rules.label: InferPotentialMentorBySimilarTeachingTopic
swrl_rules.comment: This rule proposes teacher `?t1` as a potential mentor of teacher `?t2` when:  - `?t1` is more expert than `?t2`; - `?t1` has a sufficient gamification experience level; - both teachers share the same collaborative space; - both teachers have a similar teaching topic.

swrl_rules.label: InferPotentialMentorBySimilarDomain
swrl_rules.comment: This rule proposes teacher `?t1` as a potential mentor of teacher `?t2` when:  - `?t1` is more expert than `?t2`; - `?t1` has a sufficient gamification experience level; - both teachers share the same collaborative space; - both teachers have a similar domain.

swrl_rules.label: InferMoreExpertTeacher
swrl_rules.comment: This rule infers that a teacher is more expert than another teacher when their gamification experience level is higher.

swrl_rules.label: InferSimilarTeachingTopicByEducationalTopic
swrl_rules.comment: This rule infers that two teachers have a similar teaching topic when they teach courses associated with the same educational topic.

swrl_rules.label: RecommendResourceByTeacherObjective
swrl_rules.comment: This rule recommends a gamified resource when the resource is designed with the same behavioural objective as the classroom objective associated with the course taught by the teacher.

swrl_rules.label: RecommendResourceForExperiencedTeacher
swrl_rules.comment: This rule recommends a gamified resource to a teacher only if:  - the resource is designed with the behavioural objective targeted by the course/classroom objective; - the teacher has a sufficient gamification experience level.
